parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The data quality scan task name for fuzzy match.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The list of sorting fields. Supports fields such as last modified time and creation time. Format: "SortField+SortOrder (Desc/Asc)", where Asc is the default. Valid values:

*   ModifyTime (Desc/Asc)
*   CreateTime (Desc/Asc)
*   Id (Desc/Asc)

parameters.name: Table
parameters.description: Fuzzy match for the monitored table name.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-data-quality-scans --name test --sort-by ModifyTime_Desc --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --project-id 10000 --table video_album --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListDataQualityScans --region cn-hangzhou --Table video_album --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy ModifyTime_Desc --ProjectId 10000 --Name test
